$comment: Test fixture exercising all fields of the australia-nz extension, covering both AU and NZ features

superannuationNominations.expiryRule: Three years from date of signing unless renewed
superannuationNominations.notes: Self-managed super fund with non-lapsing binding death benefit nomination in favour of spouse and eldest child. Tax-free component reflects pre-July 1983 service.

superannuationNominations.expiryRule: Lapses after three years under fund trust deed
superannuationNominations.notes: AustralianSuper industry fund with non-binding nomination. Trustee retains discretion over distribution.

familyProvisionClaims.notes: Adult son excluded from the will. Notional estate order sought over property transferred to family trust three years before death.
Former de facto partner of five years. Claim settled by mediation before filing — lump sum of $85,000 from residuary estate.

aboriginalLandDetails.successionRestrictions: Native title rights and interests are communal; individual succession not applicable
aboriginalLandDetails.notes: Native title land in the Northern Territory. Succession governed by traditional Aboriginal law and custom.

aboriginalLandDetails.nativeTitleDetermination: Granted under Aboriginal Land Rights Act 1976 (Cth)
aboriginalLandDetails.successionRestrictions: Inalienable freehold held by land trust; cannot be sold, transferred, or mortgaged
aboriginalLandDetails.notes: Inalienable freehold under ALRA 1976. The land is held in trust for traditional owners.

nzPRA.notes: Property (Relationships) Act 1976 option B elected by surviving spouse — chose to take relationship property entitlement rather than provision under the will.

testamentaryPromises.promiseDescription: Deceased promised the family bach (holiday home) in Coromandel to the claimant in return for 15 years of unpaid farm work.
testamentaryPromises.notes: Claimant is a nephew who worked on the deceased's dairy farm from 2010 to 2025 without formal employment. Multiple witnesses to the oral promise.

testamentaryPromises.promiseDescription: Deceased promised their classic car collection to the claimant in exchange for ongoing vehicle maintenance services.
testamentaryPromises.notes: Claimant is a family friend and mechanic. Written correspondence supports the promise but no formal contract exists.

notes: Composite fixture demonstrating all features of the Australia & New Zealand extension. In practice, an estate would engage either AU or NZ provisions, not both simultaneously.
